gaps.title: Service-to-protocol coordination is only partially evidenced
gaps.expected_state: Versioning, ownership, and contract rollout between service and protocol repos are explicit.
gaps.observed_state: Available evidence suggests: The reposet shows a service repo consuming a protocol repo, but coordination still depends on unresolved operator knowledge.

gaps.title: Hotspot concentration still limits autonomous change scope
